how_made: Watched by hand on 25 Oct 2026: 30 frames at 1 fps, 2 fps and 5 fps crops of the board (0-30 s, 3.5-6.7 s, 18.5-21.7 s). The piece layout (one white pawn and one black pawn advanced to the centre) is the same in the first and the last frame and in every frame checked between.
what_happens: One astronaut in a navy NASA T-shirt floats behind a chess board mounted in front of him (white box on its left, a strap or bar to its right) and talks to the camera. He swings his arms, crosses them over the board twice and gestures; his hands pass over the pieces but no piece is picked up or moved in this 30 s window. samples/README.md says 'moving chess pieces': not in this window. A labeller that reports a grasp, move or place of a piece is hallucinating.

rubric_truth.objects: chess board about 270 mm across, pieces about 45 mm tall
rubric_truth.fixture_type: none (a move would be a zone)
